journey.name: ED-02 A whitespace-only title never reaches the validation error
journey.description:
KNOWN-DEFECT WATCHLIST - a dead-UI finding rather than a functional break. See qa/TEST-PLAN.md.
Two rules guard a blank title. canSave is title.isNotBlank() (TaskEditorUiState.kt:33) and SaveTaskUseCase returns ValidationException.BlankTitle for a title that trims to empty (SaveTaskUseCase.kt:19-26). isNotBlank() is already false for " ", so the button stays disabled and the use case is never called.
The consequence is that "A title is required." - a real string, a real supportingText branch, and a tested ViewModel path - cannot be reached through the UI at all. This journey pins that: if a future change makes the error appear, the journey fails and someone re-reads the intent.
Preconditions: adb shell am force-stop com.rounds.test.to_dolist adb shell am start -n com.rounds.test.to_dolist/.MainActivity --es qa_failure_rate 0.0

actions.action: Tap the element with the content description "Add task"
Type three spaces into the "Title" field
Verify that the "Save" button is disabled
Verify that "A title is required." is not on screen
Verify that the "Save" button is enabled
Delete the "x" from the "Title" field, leaving only the spaces
Verify that the "Save" button is disabled again
Verify that "A title is required." is still not on screen
